title: Speed running the introduction phase of my new early developed horror (browser game)
author: Affectionate_Fact854
selftext:
The first floor already has placed counted 472 props scattered around the stage  
74 unique map chunks, 43 unique notes against to find and read and quite a few additional

**Workflow process**

**Day 1**

* Mainly building up documentation ,notes, building the story, building a development map and refining it with fable
* Downloading cco free assets and making sure it is actually cco

**Day 2 was chaotic**

* We switch to opus orchestration
* Grabbed my personal base developed game template
* Had swarms of subagents build all the ( back end) (Visuals)(Map chunks )(shaders) (Set up the base animations) (build the tests)(make a proper stress test suit)(Making the developers tools)

**Day 3**

* After i had fable to a audit , refine documents while i went over to manually start moving , adjusting , adding additional lighting to the stage chunks.
* Added the bases with new mechanics not yet revealed
* Polished all 3 enemies thinking scripts
* Manually went to refine all 3 enemies and the player animations while ai was busy with its own work

**Part im the happiest about ,**  
**THE FLASHLIGHT**

* Reworked the flat flashlight shadder
* Gave the flashlight a battery drain

Cant wait to see where this ends up over a 3month spread !
